items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: That band consisted of ... Jerome Richardson ... Great players. And of course, the thing that I love so much is the kind of respect that they show. ... we walked in there as kids with those guys.

ctx.x: I think it did and I would guess that has something to do with why they’ve zeroed in on that.

Well they use at least four tracks from the album, one of which is “Boy with Toys,” which I think is one of Chuck’s best. That’s the one with Jerome Richardson on soprano saxophone, and just great players.
Does that go back to that thing he did with the Paul Klee paintings?
